title: strategy.json corruption has no recovery path — bootstrap only fires on file-absent, not malformed
description: The cron prompt instructs B4: 'write valid JSON back' to ~/gig/strategy.json. This is an LLM instruction with no deterministic validation. If B4 produces malformed JSON (e.g. truncated due to context limit, unescaped characters in a learned proposal_template string, or a structural edit mistake), strategy.json exists on disk but contains invalid JSON. The bootstrap guard ('if ~/gig/strategy.json does not exist, copy strategy.default.json') fires only when the file is absent. It does NOT fire when the file exists with malformed content. On the subsequent pass, 'Read ~/gig/strategy.json' returns the malformed content. The LLM may: (a) fail to parse APPLIED_IDS (the derived list of already-applied requestIds), causing dedup to break (B2 can double-apply), (b) fail to read max_apply_per_pass (B2 applies unlimited requests), (c) fail to read skip_categories (B2 applies to all categories), or (d) stall mid-pass. There is no try/parse-fallback-to-default path anywhere in the codebase.

evidence.snippet: STRATEGY BOOTSTRAP: if ~/gig/strategy.json does not exist, copy ~/anicca/skills/earn/gig/strategy.default.json to ~/gig/strategy.json. ... (c) update ~/gig/strategy.json: ... write valid JSON back

additionalEvidence.note: Tests validate strategy.default.json (the static seed), never the live strategy.json after a B4 write. No test exercises the corrupted-JSON recovery scenario.

fix: Add a shell-level validity check in the cron prompt: 'python3 -c "import json,sys; json.load(open(\"$HOME/gig/strategy.json\"))" 2>/dev/null || cp ~/anicca/skills/earn/gig/strategy.default.json ~/gig/strategy.json'. Place this AFTER B4 writes strategy.json (self-healing for the next pass) and BEFORE reading it at pass start (recover from a prior corruption). Alternatively, have B4 write to strategy.json.tmp, validate it with python3 -c 'import json,open(...)' then mv to strategy.json only on success.
